subject: general
question: Pushkar Mela is a popular cultural festival of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pushkar Mela:-**

 
 
• **It is a popular cultural festival in Rajasthan.**
 
• It is held annually in the town of Pushkar in Ajmer district of Rajasthan.
 
• **The festival is primarily a livestock fair where thousands of camels, horses, and cattle are traded.**
 
• Apart from the livestock fair, Pushkar Mela also features various cultural and religious activities such as music and dance performances, camel races, and a holy dip in the Pushkar Lake.
 
• **Pushkar Mela attracts a large number of tourists from all over the world who come to witness the unique cultural extravaganza. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam:-**

 
 
• It is known for its Bihu festival which is a celebration of the harvest season.
 
 
 
• **Bihar:-**
 
 
• It is famous for the Chhath Puja which is a festival dedicated to the Sun God.
 
 
 
• **Sikkim:-**
 
 
• It is known for the Losoong festival which is a celebration of the Tibetan New Year.
